units.source_text: 且说北山僧寺里的老尼姑，病情好转，回京城来了。

en.t: Now the old nun from the temple in the Northern Hills had recovered somewhat from her illness and returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 源氏公子探得了她的住处，时时致信问候。

en.t: Prince Genji found out where she was staying and often sent letters to ask after her health.

units.source_text: 老尼姑的回信总是谢绝之辞，这也是当然之理。

en.t: The old nun's replies were always words of refusal, which was only natural.

units.source_text: 近几月来，为了藤壶妃子之事，源氏公子心事重重，

en.t: In recent months, because of the matter of Lady Fujitsubo, Prince Genji had been weighed down with anxiety,

units.source_text: 无暇他顾，所以平安无事地过去了。

en.t: and had no leisure to think of anything else, so the matter passed without incident.

units.source_text: 到了暮秋时分，源氏公子寂寞无聊，常常忧愁叹息。

en.t: When late autumn came, Prince Genji felt lonely and restless, and often sighed in sorrow.

units.source_text: 有一天月白风清之夜，难得心情好转，

en.t: One night, when the moon was bright and the wind was clear, his spirits improved for once,

units.source_text: 便出门去访问他的情妇。

en.t: so he went out to visit his lover.

units.source_text: 天空忽然降下一番时雨。

en.t: A sudden passing shower began to fall from the sky.

units.source_text: 要去的地方是六条京极，从宫中到那里，似觉路程很远。

en.t: His destination was Rokujo Kyogoku, and from the palace the road there seemed very long.

units.source_text: 途中看见一所荒芜的邸宅，其中古木参天，阴气逼人。

en.t: On the way he saw a desolate mansion, where ancient trees towered into the sky and the gloom seemed oppressive.

units.source_text: 一向刻不离身的惟光言道：“这便是已故按察大纳言[\[23\]](#part1334.html#m23)的邸宅。

en.t: Koremitsu, who was always at his side, said, "This is the mansion of the late Azechi Dainagon[\[23\]](#part1334.html#m23).

units.source_text: 前些日子我因事经过此地，乘便进去访问，听那少纳言乳母说：那老尼姑身体衰弱，毫无希望了。”

en.t: A few days ago I passed this way on an errand and stopped in to visit; the nurse Shonagon told me that the old nun was weak and there was no hope for her."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“很可怜啊！

en.t: Prince Genji said, "How pitiful!

units.source_text: 我该去慰问一下，你为什么不早点告诉我呢？

en.t: I ought to have gone to visit and comfort her. Why did you not tell me sooner?

units.source_text: 现在就叫人进去通报吧。”

en.t: Send someone in at once to announce my visit."

units.source_text: 惟光便派一个随从进去通报，并且吩咐他：但言公子是专诚来访的。

en.t: Koremitsu then sent a retainer inside to announce them, instructing him to say only that the prince had come especially to call.

units.source_text: 随从走进去，对应门的侍女说：“源氏公子专诚前来拜访师姑。”

en.t: The retainer went in and said to the maid who answered the gate, "Prince Genji has come especially to pay his respects to the reverend lady."

units.source_text: 侍女吃惊地答道：“啊呀，这怎么好呢！

en.t: The maid answered in surprise, "Oh dear, what are we to do?

units.source_text: 师姑近日病势沉重，不能见客呀！”

en.t: The reverend lady's illness has been very grave lately, and she cannot receive visitors!"

units.source_text: 但她又想：就此打发他回去，毕竟是失礼的。

en.t: But then she thought that simply sending him away like this would, after all, be discourteous.

units.source_text: 便打扫起一间朝南的厢房来，请公子进来坐憩。

en.t: So she had a south-facing side room cleaned and invited the prince inside to sit and rest.
